requests.what: Under its own rule 3, a to-battery member with no shunt falls back to clip for the unaccepted part. At the flywheel's 2 A (96 W) limit and 180 W at the bus, flywheel-brake-to-battery therefore moves exactly like flywheel-brake-clip, and to-battery and shunt both brake at the full 2 N·m. Give flywheel-brake-to-battery a charge limit that accepts the whole surplus (5 A, 240 W). Replace 'three different trajectories' (acceptance) and 'three distinct final speeds' (e2e paragraph) with 'three distinct ledger lines; clip alone changes the motion: ω(0.2 s) = 89.24 rad/s against 80 rad/s'. N15b-30 now asserts this.

Its script runs `frob sim run discharge-40a`, but no bead defines that fixture design. Define it (presumably bus-48v's battery and harness under a constant 40 A load to exhaustion at 900 s, synthetic). N15b-16 also uses it, and N15b-17 now owns its own `discharge-40a-ageing`.
